subject: Custom availability exhibit & order form language — CareDynamics
messages:
From: Ethan Walters <ethan.walters@caredynamics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@caredynamics.com
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: availability exhibit for enterprise MSA

Hi Jasmine / Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. CareDynamics is excited about Redwood, but our legal and operations teams need explicit availability and latency commitments as an exhibit to the MSA (we run regulated clinical workflows and need clear operational remedies).

Can you share a proposed availability exhibit and the order form language that would reconcile with our MSA (we have automated failover requirements and a 99.95% monthly uptime target, with crediting tied to measured per-route latency breaches)? Attached is a short requirements doc from our ops team.

Attached: CareDynamics_Requirements_20260823.pdf (1.2MB - PDF)

We'd like to get a first-pass by end of day Wednesday so our procurement can prepare redlines.

Best,
Ethan
Director of Platform Ops
CareDynamics
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walters <ethan.walters@caredynamics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: availability exhibit for enterprise MSA

Ethan — thanks for the clear requirements doc. We're on it.

Plan: Ben will draft an availability exhibit and sample order form language that maps to your 99.95% target and the latency breach metrics you described. Karthik (procurement) will confirm the commercial approach for credits and any SLA exceptions for scheduled maintenance. I'll coordinate evidence for our monitoring and fallbacks (prefix caching, cross-region failover).

Ben — can you take the draft + order form snippet? Karthik, do you need any commercial guardrails (caps, credit windows) called out now?

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ethan Walters <ethan.walters@caredynamics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: availability exhibit + order form snippet (vA)

Hi all —

Attached is our first-pass: "SLA_Exhibit_Proposal_vA.docx" with:
- Definitions: Measurement window, downtime calculation, latency breach thresholds (p50/p95/p99 per route).
- Remedies: Service credit schedule tied to monthly uptime percentage, with a cap at 50% of monthly fees.
- Exceptions: Scheduled maintenance windows, customer misconfiguration, third-party network incidents.

Order form snippet included noting the model variants that will be covered, and the dedicated capacity vs hosted fallbacks. I tried to align with CareDynamics' 99.95% ask while keeping our typical financial cap.

Attachments: SLA_Exhibit_Proposal_vA.docx (23KB - DOCX)

Open questions for CareDynamics legal:
- Are automated failover SLOs (cross-region) a hard requirement or a preferred control?
- Do you require credits to be calculated per-route or account-wide?

Ethan — if you can flag anything immediate, we'll iterate today.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@caredynamics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@caredynamics.com, Ethan Walters <ethan.walters@caredynamics.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: availability exhibit + order form snippet (vA)

Ben / Jasmine —

Thanks for the quick turn. Our legal team reviewed and uploaded redlines. High level: we need the crediting to be route-specific (critical workflows cannot be diluted across lower-priority routes), and we want an uptime definition that excludes recoveries shorter than 5 minutes if automatic failover completed successfully.

I've attached a redlined PDF and included a few comments inline about evidence (we need a standardized CSV export of uptime measurements and an audit log showing failover initiation).

Attachments: CareDynamics_SLA_Redlines_20260824.pdf (18KB - PDF)

--
Sarah Kim
Senior Counsel, CareDynamics
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@caredynamics.com>, Ethan Walters <ethan.walters@caredynamics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: availability exhibit + order form snippet (vA)

Sarah — thanks for the redlines. Quick responses to the two points you raised:

1) Route-specific credits: We can support per-route calculation. That will require mapping your critical route identifiers to deployed route names in the order form; Ben/Aditya can include a mapping appendix in the order form.

2) Recovery exclusion window: We can adopt your 5-minute auto-failover exclusion for uptime calculations provided we include the evidence export format you requested (CSV with timestamps and status codes) and a mutually-agreed reconciliation window (we propose 30 days to raise disputes).

I'm looping in Evelyn (Ops) to confirm the export format and Karthik to align on the commercial cap and dispute window. We'll produce a tracked-change exhibit and updated order form by EOD and send it via DocuSign link for your review.

Related: HubSpot deal link and a draft DocuSign packet are below.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@caredynamics.com>, Ethan Walters <ethan.walters@caredynamics.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: availability exhibit + order form snippet (vA)

Sarah / Ethan —

Great — we can take those redlines. We'll update the exhibit to:
- Explicit route mapping appendix
- Include CSV evidence export example and audit log fields (timestamp, route_id, status_code, failover_flag)
- Keep the credit cap but add a 30-day dispute window as Jasmine proposed

I'll push the tracked-change exhibit and an updated order form this evening and initiate the DocuSign packet. Expect the link in your inbox shortly.

Thanks everyone — moving to signature once legal confirms the minor edits.

Ben
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced in thread: CareDynamics_Requirements_20260823.pdf; SLA_Exhibit_Proposal_vA.docx; CareDynamics_SLA_Redlines_20260824.pdf
